event: A scraping sound comes up, and the task is to determine the direction of the sounding object relative to a hypothetical robot's position and facing.

sounding_object.description: A dark-colored metal frying pan, approximately 10-12 inches in diameter. The sound is produced when it's being scraped/cleaned by the man in the green shirt at the kitchen island sink.

reference_object.description: A low, rectangular coffee table made of light-colored wood, located in the center of the living room area. The robot is hypothetically standing by this table.

facing_object.description: A flat-screen TV mounted above a fireplace. The fireplace has a light-colored stone/brick facade and a mantel. Located on the far wall of the living room. The robot is hypothetically facing this object.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the rectangular wooden coffee table and facing the tv by the fireplace, when the scraping sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: left, right, or back? If the object is generally to your left and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees left, choose 'left'. If the object is generally to your right and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees right, choose 'right'. If the object is generally behind you and facing it requires turning 120 degrees or more, choose 'back'.
